rationalization_narrative: Our rationalization strategy involves decommissioning 154 out of 195 applications due to redundancy and consolidation opportunities, with only 41 applications retained for their unique capabilities. Consolidation efforts will significantly reduce infrastructure costs while maintaining critical business functions.

migration_roadmap.description: Validate system performance and optimize processes for improved efficiency and cost savings.

decommission_rationale: Decommissioning recommendations are based on the high redundancy of capabilities across multiple applications, with a total of 154 applications identified as redundant. For instance, 'MFG Planning Hub 2180' provides 3 out of 6 related production planning and scheduling capabilities, indicating that decommissioning this application would not impact critical business functions.
